intro.title: Strings are sequences of characters
intro.body: Index and slice them like lists. Methods such as upper() and split() return new strings because strings never change in place.
intro.sample:
word = "contest"
print(word[0])      # c
print(word[-1])     # t
print(word[:3])     # con
